panel.help:
Commands act on this preview:
  app NAME         open that process's terminal session
  status           where the preview stands
  rebuild          fetch the latest commit, rebuild and restart
  stop, start      stop or start the preview
  fix              send the agent in to fix a failed preview
  open             open the app in a new tab
  theme NAME       change the terminal colours
  clear            clear the output (Ctrl+L)
Up and Down walk through earlier commands.
